title.narrative: Inclusive and Resilient Dairy Development Project II

description.narrative: The Inclusive and Resilient Dairy Development (IRDD) project will be implemented in Hai and Siha Districts of the Kilimanjaro Region by the Kilimanjaro Dairy Cooperative Joint Enterprise (KDCJE), a member-based organization representing 17 primary dairy cooperatives. The project aims to strengthen the dairy value chain and improve the sustainable livelihoods of smallholder dairy-farming families. The main purpose of the project is to build an inclusive and climate-resilient dairy sector that enhances productivity, income, gender equality, and food security. The project will reach 7,252 beneficiaries, including 1,813 direct participants (1,559 women and 254 men). Key expected results include; stronger and more accountable cooperative institutions; increased productivity and income among dairy farmers; adoption of climate-resilient practices; improved gender equality at institutional and household levels; and enhanced access to nutritious food for farming families. Main activities include capacity building for cooperatives, training on improved dairy practices, climate-resilient technologies, gender-responsive approaches, youth enterprise development, policy advocacy, and communication. A school milk programme will also support child nutrition.
